transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

I can’t shake this feeling that I’m a terrible person and that everything that’s gone wrong is my fault, like I’ve already messed up my whole life. My aunt and my pastor insisted I come talk to someone because I just can't get out of this dark place.

When you feel this way, have you ever heard voices or become convinced of things other people say aren’t true, like that you deserve punishment or have ruined everything? Also, has this kind of depressive episode happened before, or is this the first time?

It’s hard to admit, but late at night I hear a man's voice behind my left ear telling me I'm worthless and disappointed God, and I'm convinced He has cursed me and everyone can see it. This is the first time I've ever experienced anything like this; it all started about a year ago when I got overwhelmed with my GED and work, and I never had these thoughts or heard voices before then.
